# Club Mahindra

> > Club Mahindra is a vacation ownership and resort membership platform offering curated experiences, dining, activities, and accommodations across India and international destinations.

Club Mahindra provides members access to resort properties in popular destinations like Goa, Kerala, Himachal Pradesh, and international locations including Orlando, Finland, and Sweden. The platform emphasizes family-friendly vacation experiences with diverse dining options, adventure activities, cultural experiences, and beach destinations.

## Key Topics
